title: Circuit of a program
statement: Let $n,m,w$ be natural numbers, let $kappa$ be a type with a chosen element, let $F$ assign an output bit list to each element of $kappa$ and input bit list, and let $prog$ be a finite instruction list. Its output is the vertex assigned to instruction $i$ and bit $j$ when $i$ is within the program and $j<w$, and is the input vertex $n$ otherwise.
